name: "Beef Stroganoff" Noodle Soup with Mushrooms, Carrot, Celery & Parsley

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
0.68 kg cremini mushrooms
3 medium carrots
3 sticks celery
1 small bunch Italian (flat-leaf) parsley

instructions.primary_message: Thinly slice mushrooms. Place in a large bowl.
Peel, trim, and slice carrots crosswise into thin rounds. Add to the bowl with the mushrooms.
Preheat a large pot over medium heat.
While the pot heats up, trim and small dice celery. Add to the bowl.
Once the pot is hot, add butter and swirl to coat the bottom. Add veggies and cook, stirring occasionally, until soft, 5-6 minutes.
Meanwhile, use your hands to break the pasta into 2-inch pieces.
When the veggies are soft, add flour to the pot. Cook, stirring frequently, for 1 minute.

Add pasta, broth, milk, Worcestershire, salt, and pepper to the pot; stir to combine the soup and bring to a boil over high heat. Once boiling, reduce heat to low and simmer, stirring occasionally, until noodles are almost tender and soup has thickened, 10-12 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
1774 ml chicken or vegetable broth
355 ml whole milk
1 tbsp Worcestershire sauce
1 ½ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add half to the soup and set remaining parsley aside for serving.
Pat the steak dry with paper towels and place on a cutting board. Slice in half lengthwise, then cut crosswise (against the grain) into thin strips.
When the noodles are almost tender, add beef slices to the soup. Continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until beef and noodles are cooked through, 4-5 minutes more. Remove from heat.
To serve, divide soup between bowls and top with reserved parsley. Enjoy!
